name: CM50_every_capability_runs_in_the_pipeline
origins: user requirement 2026-11-05 (every capability in the main pipeline, with its tier and a coverage check)
statement: Every capability runs in the main pipeline: its card declares the tier of the evidence that run gives (CM46) and the verify sections or self-run steps that exercise its engine, and the pipeline check holds each declared stage to the code (it must reach the capability's modules). A capability that no stage runs, or part of one, is a recorded gap with its reason, what would close it and the goal that counts it; a capability with neither a run nor a gap fails verify. The smoke check (CM37) does not count as running. Each card also records its Gödel verdict (GODEL_AUDIT §2: CORE, KEYED, CONSUMER, or NO with its reason i-v): a CORE or KEYED capability whose code does not call the core, and any code outside engines/godel.py and godel1931.py that defines primes, content or the zigzag, is a recorded impurity with its goal or fails.
